method: Real requestAnimationFrame intervals in integrated playable district; first 60 frames excluded; rolling 600 samples. Moving subset requires actual displacement. CPU submission is not GPU time. No showcase extrapolation.
limitations: One local Mac/Chromium 156 session, refresh-rate limited. Phone sizes are desktop viewport emulations, not mobile hardware benchmarks. Camera, culling and quality affect geometry and calls.
